Problem Statement
Read a word and count how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, in either case) it contains, using a loop combined with if-else statements.
Description
Read a string word into a character array using scanf. Use a loop to examine each character of the string up to its null terminator, and use if-else statements to check whether the character is a vowel (uppercase or lowercase). Count the number of vowels found and print the count.
Input Description
A single word with no spaces.
Output Description
Print the number of vowels in the word.
